text: @dpskh/tool-checkpoint 是为 DSH 提供会话检查点标记的插件，注册 checkpoint 工具和 ctx.checkpoint 服务。工具在探索开始时记录会话日志长度、当前回合和可选目标，并把标记持久保存于按会话关联的插件存储域；服务还可读取最新标记、查询是否仍待折叠并在折叠完成后更新状态。它适合需要将多步探索交给配套 rewind 插件收束为报告、同时保留完整会话日志的 DSH 使用场景。挂载时需提供 DSH 的存储域与 agent 会话服务。

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint marks a DSH session position before multi-step exploration. It stores the log length, open turn, and optional objective for a session. The ctx.checkpoint service exposes marks for a companion rewind plugin to fold. DSH storage-domain and agent-session services are required.
我想给多步调查先做个标记，之后方便收起中间过程。
有没有办法记录当前会话位置，留给后续上下文整理？
让 DSH 在探索开始时保存一个可供后续折叠的检查点。
多次读文件和搜索之后，怎样只保留结论并找到起点？
I need to mark where a multi-step investigation begins so I can fold it later.
How can I save a session checkpoint before doing exploratory tool calls?
Let DSH keep a durable marker for the start of an investigation.
I want a companion rewind workflow to know which session position to use.
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint 的功能「记录会话检查点」：checkpoint 工具可接收可选 objective，并保存会话日志长度、当前回合和目标，返回标记编号及日志长度。
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint 的功能「查询最新标记」：ctx.checkpoint.latestMark 按 session id 读取最新持久标记，供配套 rewind 流程确定要处理的检查点。
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint 的功能「判断折叠状态」：ctx.checkpoint.hasActive 检查是否存在尚未完成折叠的标记，帮助配套流程判断该会话是否仍有待处理检查点。
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint 的功能「完成折叠标记」：折叠成功后调用 completeFold 更新对应标记；已折叠、未知或编号不匹配的标记不会被重复更新。
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint 只记录惰性的检查点，不会自行折叠探索内容；要把标记后的过程收束为报告，需配合 rewind 插件。
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint 的工具调用需要拥有 agent session；没有会话的调用会报错，因标记状态按 session id 保存。
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint 提供工具 checkpoint：Creates a context checkpoint before exploratory work so you can later rewind and keep only a concise report.
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint 提供设置项 toolName：Model-facing tool name (default checkpoint).

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint README · Introduction：

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint — checkpoint marker for the DeepSeek Harness

English | [中文](README.zh.md) [](https://dshfind.com/zh/plugins/dpskh/dsh-checkpoint?ref=badge)

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint README · Introduction：One package, one entry plugin. Mounting `@dpskh/tool-checkpoint` provides `ctx.checkpoint` (a service that durably records a checkpoint mark in the plugin-owned storage domain, keyed by session id) and the model-facing `checkpoint` tool over it. The marker records the conversation position an exploration starts from; the sibling [`@dpskh/tool-rewind`](https://github.com/dpskh/dsh-rewind) plugin folds everything after the marker into an auto-generated report, keeping the exploration's noisy middle (reads, searches, experiments) out of the model-visible context while the durable log retains the full exploration for audit. This plugin never folds anything itself — the marker stays inert until a rewind.

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint README · Introduction：The mark is **not a session event**: it lives in the `checkpoint` storage domain (`~/.dsh/storages/checkpoint.json`), so the durable session log stays purely core-vocabulary and remains readable by any harness — an out-of-repo plugin event would be refused by harnesses whose vocabulary lacks it. `rewind` consumes marks exclusively through this service.

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint README · Configuration：```yaml
- id: tool-checkpoint
  name: '@dpskh/tool-checkpoint'
  config:
    toolName: checkpoint   # model-facing tool name (default checkpoint)

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint README · Working together：The marker only earns its keep with a fold: mount both plugins so `rewind` can collapse the exploration the marker anchors. `checkpoint` alone records inert markers; `rewind` alone has nothing to fold and fails with a no-checkpoint error.

```yaml
- id: tool-checkpoint
  name: '@dpskh/tool-checkpoint'
- id: tool-rewind
  name: '@dpskh/tool-rewind'        # https://github.com/dpskh/dsh-rewind

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint README · Model Experience：Directly: the `checkpoint` tool call and its `{ id, logLength }` result. The tool description teaches the mark-then-rewind workflow; a `tool:checkpoint` system-prompt section makes it a standing instruction (mark before any investigation that will take more than one tool call, rewind before finishing the turn). The marker itself never enters the model-visible history and never enters the session log.
@dpskh/tool-checkpoint README · KV Cache effect：Prefix-stable: the tool schema is fixed; markers are storage records, not session events, so they never alter the request prefix.

@dpskh/tool-checkpoint README · Known Limitations and Deferred Work：- **Marker without a rewind is inert** — a checkpoint that is never rewound costs nothing but leaves the exploration in context; the workflow depends on the model pairing mark and rewind.
- **One fold per marker** — `rewind` folds from the most recent marker; folding the same marker twice is rejected as an empty region.
